categories.main_business_segments: Nayuki Holdings Limited operates primarily in the freshly-made tea drinks and baked goods sector through its Nayuki teahouses. The company also has a ready-to-drink beverage segment and a growing franchise business. Its operations include self-operated stores, franchise stores, and sales through online food delivery platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high-quality, healthy products using fresh fruits, premium tea leaves, and fresh milk instead of syrups, tea powders, or creamers. It employs digitalization and automation technologies such as automatic tea-making equipment and automatic shift scheduling systems to enhance operational efficiency. Product innovation is continuous, with numerous new beverage and baked goods products launched annually.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nayuki serves consumers seeking premium, freshly-made tea drinks and complementary baked goods, targeting mainly urban customers in China. It also caters to customers through ready-to-drink beverages and retail products like gift tea boxes and seasonal gift sets. The franchise business targets mid and low-tier cities where self-operated stores have less presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates predominantly in mainland China, with a network of 1,798 Nayuki teahouses across 112 cities, including Tier 1, New Tier 1, and Tier 2 cities. It has also expanded internationally into markets such as Thailand, Macau SAR, Singapore, and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nayuki operates primarily at the downstream retail level as a chain operator of teahouses selling freshly-made tea drinks and baked goods. It manages its supply chain and product distribution capabilities to support its expanding store network and product offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group focuses on a green and healthy strategy, emphasizing high-quality, low-sugar products. It prioritizes continuous product innovation, launching numerous new beverages and baked goods annually. Strategic priorities include expanding the teahouse network, optimizing store formats, advancing franchise and international markets, and enhancing operational efficiency through technology and supply chain improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from product sales at Nayuki self-operated stores, including freshly-made tea drinks, baked goods, and other retail products. Additional revenue streams include sales from ready-to-drink beverages and franchise business fees. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery or customer acceptance, including online delivery orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nayuki is positioned as a leading premium modern teahouse brand in China, competing in the freshly-made tea drinks industry. The market is highly competitive with continuous influx of new and crossover brands, which has intensified competition and pressured store revenues. Nayuki differentiates itself through its dual category model of tea drinks plus European soft bread and its focus on product quality and customer experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB4.92 billion, a 4.7% decrease from 2023, with an adjusted net loss of RMB918.7 million compared to a profit in 2023. The Group operates 1,453 self-operated stores and 345 franchise stores. Despite recent revenue pressure and profitability decline, the Group maintains substantial cash reserves (RMB2.69 billion) and continues to invest in network expansion and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nayuki emphasizes high-quality, healthy, and cost-effective tea drinks and baked goods with less sugar and fresh ingredients, creating a lifestyle brand for modern consumers. Its unique dual category model combining freshly-made tea drinks with European soft bread offers differentiated customer value. The company also provides a comfortable social space and a strong membership program to enhance customer loyalty and experience.
